premises.text: Personalization can significantly improve user engagement and conversion rates
premises.evidence_span: we had a 241% improvement in click-through rate, a 150% improvement in engagement. In this case, those were bids for them. And a 102% improvement in actual on-revenue new conversion.

premises.text: Current personalization methods are ineffective because they rely on historical data
premises.evidence_span: the problem is none of that really targets you at this very moment in time.

premises.text: LiftIgniter's platform personalizes content in real-time for every user
premises.evidence_span: we built a platform for every single vertical across all types of content, across every single touchpoint, and across all devices.

premises.text: The integration of LiftIgniter's platform is quick and easy for customers
premises.evidence_span: it took minutes to integrate, not months.

premises.text: LiftIgniter processes user actions in real-time to provide immediate personalized responses
premises.evidence_span: every time that a user takes an action, it's processed by our algorithms, it's returned to the site, all in 125 millisecond round trip.

premises.text: LiftIgniter can handle a large volume of data and user interactions
premises.evidence_span: we scan over 300 million items a day. We have 350 billion signals that we're gathering a month.

premises.text: LiftIgniter's pricing model is usage-based, making it flexible for customers
premises.evidence_span: our pricing is usage-based, which means that it's very easy for our customers to add new items and new parts of the site that they want to start personalizing.

value.text: Users receive personalized content that enhances their experience and engagement
value.evidence_span: you give them the items they love, the items they want to buy, and the items they want to share.

notes: Claims about growth and profitability are excluded as traction.
